Real Estate Brokers, Sales Persons and Rental Location Agents
Duties of Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons

law.text: Any document or record required to be maintained by a licensee under this chapter may be an electronic record in accordance with the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (§ 59.1-479 et seq.).
